main_measure.name: t of mean of (forecast/10) x 2-bar excess return on Sunday bars
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (confirm, with supporting check); mean < 0 with t <= -2 (reject)

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean of sign(forecast) x excess, by |forecast|

decided_by: t >= 2 but the supporting check fails (top third by |forecast| does not beat the bottom third).
reading: Cases are Sunday bars (timestamp day of week = Sunday) with regime mean_reversion and a close two bars later in the same window, including any with forecast 0; the coin's mean 2-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid (positions 0,2,4,... of each window) pooled over all its windows; thirds are floor(n/3) cases at each end after sorting by |forecast|.
